business_impact: One synthetic ticket cannot complete asynchronous processing because its event permanently violates the worker contract. Other valid work continues through the same consumer.
reproduction: Publish an event for a valid queued ticket using unsupported event_type=ticket.unsupported. The worker remains healthy, retries deterministically to its configured ceiling, then quarantines the event; unchanged replay would fail again.
evidence: same request ID correlated across every failed delivery
worker consumer remains registered and healthy
configured bounded retry ceiling is reached
message quarantines exactly once with original correlation metadata
healthy tickets complete through the same worker during the incident
API, PostgreSQL, Redis, and RabbitMQ remain healthy
quarantined payload contains unsupported event_type while ticket reference is valid
steps_already_performed: rejected consumer loss and broad dependency outage
preserved the original quarantined payload and headers
did not restart the worker, purge queues, or blindly replay the message
suspected_component: upstream event producer / asynchronous event contract
requested_action: Owning application team to confirm the supported event contract and approve payload correction or producer fix before replaying quarantined work outside the controlled exercise.
